Idli's form for this file now has a "Valid rows only" rule. It keeps only rows that pass every check, so your species count and mean days can use just those rows. All tests pass, including a new one for this rule. I checked its numbers on the fake-data copy separately with pandas.

- **Rule:** a row counts as valid when scientific name, processing and seed treatment are filled in. No. and seed depth must be numbers. Days must be 1–365 and % germination 0–100.
- **Your question on the fake copy:** 28 species, with a mean of 23.9 days. Those figures are fake. Your real file will give its own numbers.

This is a copy with fake values, so nothing here changed your file. I saved the skill as version 2 and wrote `done.json`. I also created `go_back`, so you're switching back to Idli, and your chat there will continue.
